from pathlib import Path
import json

TARGET="DEV-PRED-A2Z-DIRECT-SOL-REGRESSION-N1E36-20261007"
state=Path.home()/".local/state/prediction-project-executor"/(TARGET+".json")
wt_default=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/worktrees"/TARGET

print("TARGET="+TARGET)
print("STATE_PATH="+str(state))
print("STATE_EXISTS="+str(state.is_file()))

if not state.is_file():
    raise SystemExit(2)

obj=json.loads(state.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
keys=("task_id","status","exit_code","source_commit","remote_commit","worktree","branch","claimed_at_utc","completed_at_utc","error","operation_count","operations","operation_results","results")
for key in keys:
    if key in obj:
        val=obj[key]
        text=json.dumps(val,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)
        if len(text)>12000:
            text=text[:12000]+"...<TRUNCATED>"
        print(key.upper()+"="+text)

wt=Path(obj.get("worktree") or wt_default)
print("WORKTREE="+str(wt))
print("WORKTREE_EXISTS="+str(wt.exists()))
testp=wt/"tests/model_execution/test_direct_sol_chat.py"
print("TEST_FILE_EXISTS="+str(testp.is_file()))

# Deterministic classification from persisted executor receipt only; this script does not run tests.
status=str(obj.get("status") or "")
exit_code=obj.get("exit_code")
blob=json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)
ran_target=("tests/model_execution/test_direct_sol_chat.py" in blob and "unittest" in blob)
print("TARGET_TEST_REFERENCED="+str(ran_target))
print("EXECUTOR_PASS="+str(status.upper()=="PASS" and exit_code==0))
